items.description: ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, LyondellBasell, Huntsman, Celanese — Houston's energy majors and the broader Texas petrochemical ecosystem. Upstream: production decline curve analysis, well interference detection, artificial lift optimization, production forecasting. Midstream: pipeline integrity monitoring from in-line inspection data, compressor station anomaly detection, NGL fractionation process optimization. Downstream/Refining: equipment reliability prediction from vibration and process sensor data, product quality prediction from process parameters, energy efficiency optimization for refinery unit operations. Trading and Origination: commodity price analytics, freight cost optimization, market intelligence AI.
